INCLUDE(DownloadVerified)

SET(CATCH2_VERSION "3.14.0")
#SHA256 of v${CATCH2_VERSION}.tar.gz: change it when the version changes
SET(CATCH2_SHA256 "ba2a939efead3c833c499cf487e185762f419a71d30158cd1b43c6079c586490")
SET(CATCH2_SRC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Catch2-${CATCH2_VERSION}")
IF (NOT EXISTS ${CATCH2_SRC_DIR})
  SET(CATCH2_ARCHIVE "Catch2-${CATCH2_VERSION}.tar.gz")
  SET(CATCH2_URL "https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2/archive/refs/tags/v${CATCH2_VERSION}.tar.gz")
  DOWNLOAD_VERIFIED(${CATCH2_URL}
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${CATCH2_ARCHIVE}
                    ${CATCH2_SHA256}
                    "Catch2 v${CATCH2_VERSION}")
  EXECUTE_PROCESS(COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E tar xzf ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${CATCH2_ARCHIVE} WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
ENDIF()

ADD_SUBDIRECTORY(${CATCH2_SRC_DIR})
